title: Listen
summary: LIST'EN, verb intransitive lis'n. 1. To hearken; to give ear; to attend closely with a view to hear. On the green bank I sat, and listened long. 2. To obey; to yield to advice; to follow admonition. L

inlines.v: LIST'EN, verb intransitive lis'n. 1. To hearken; to give ear; to attend closely with a view to hear. On the green bank I sat, and listened long. 2. To obey; to yield to advice; to follow admonition. LIS'TEN, verb transitive lis'n. To hear; to attend.
